notes.title: Patch 1.13.5
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers! Our first patch is here:

- Fixed a soft lock in Chapter 6 (you could stay trapped on the small island)
- Various Translations fixes/improvements

We'd appreciate if you could leave a review for the game so that it will help get the ball rolling, thank you so much! Counting on you folks!

Cheers

notes.title: Sci-fi point and click adventure Murder On Space Station 52 is out now
notes.notes:
Point and click murder mystery, Murder On Space Station 52, has released with Linux support from developer Made From Strings.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/09/sci-fi-point-and-click-adventure-murder-on-space-station-52-is-out-now

notes.title: Get Ready, Murder on Space Station 52 Has Landed!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce the official release of Murder on Space Station 52! Dive into a meticulously crafted space station filled with secrets, treachery, and a mystery that puts your survival on the line.

We’d love for you to embark on this thrilling journey and uncover the truth lurking in the shadows. Your experience and feedback mean the world to us! Every review helps elevate the game and bring it to the attention of fellow adventurers.

Thank you for your support, and enjoy the mystery!

notes.title: Updated DEMO - New languages and Features! Please review!
notes.notes:
Hey all, hope you are preparing for a grand sci-fi mystery on 25th of September!

In view of the release of the game, we have released a new update to the demo which, streamlines the experience with the full release, so you see what you really get with the full game:

- French, Italian, German and Spanish Translations
- Added options screen (adjust vol levels, text skipping etc)
- More savegames
- Double click for faster exits
- Fixed VOs
- Optimized game size

Now the demo has a separate page and you can also leave a review as per Steam's latest update! So if you enjoy it, please leave one, it would help us alot!

See you soon at the Station!

notes.title: Murder on Space Station 52 Dev Walkthrough
notes.notes:
Hey all!

Just to give an update: the game is in it's final stages of development (polishing actually) and the release date will be announced very soon. Initially it will be released for PC (Win, Mac, Linux), Consoles and Mobiles will follow.

Here's a new dev walkthrough by Chris Mathes (game's solo dev), who explains the basic mechanics of the game, pretty familiar to pnc gamers ofcourse. It also reveals the Murder board and in the in-game currency which is earned by epxloring the world.
